text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As tryouts draw near, hopeful students are
given a chance to
demonstrate their
abilities to trainers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to observe the students' training
progress, I head off to the
course, when an
indignant voice catches my attention.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gosh, I've already said this a million times!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I do have talent! I'm going to prove it at the tryouts and procure myself a first-rate trainer! If you don't believe me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then there's nothing more I have to say to
you. Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Geez, doesn't she know that I don't have time to talk on the phone right now—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Wh-who are you? A stalker?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly clear up the misunderstanding by
introducing myself as a
new trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Well then, excuse me. But
consider yourself lucky that
you were able
to catch me by surprise. It's a rare sight, so
let's call it
even.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what's with the face? Do you not
understand how grateful you
should be
right now?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... Do you not know who I
am?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My goodness me, what a travesty! We
mustn't waste any time—follow
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She forcibly drags me along to the central
square.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All right everyone, assemble!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Followers
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What's happening, King?

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Who's this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A new trainer. But for some reason, this
person has no idea who I am!
Isn't that just
absolutely tragic?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's time for a proper
introduction!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Followers
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's what I like to hear! Let's
begin!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What's my name?

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Followers
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What am I?

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A winner!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How's my future?

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Bright and beloved!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's right! For I am the one and only—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what's with that empty look on your
face? Where's my
applause?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I just went out of my way to do a whole
self-introduction for you! You
should be
crying tears of joy while clapping!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed it was. I'm sure the introduction has
told you all that you need
to know—that
the elegant, charming, and dignified King
is a first-rate
racer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Surely now you understand the sheer
magnificence, the intelligence,
and the
expectations that I embody. And how it's
only natural for the
entire school to be
captivated by me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What?! How could that possibly have
flown over your head? You...

good-for-nothing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Very well, once more from the top!
Everyone, get in your
positions!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But King, shouldn't you get going soon?

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, didn't you say you were going to be
training with the others
today to prepare
for the tryouts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training course is already filled with
students going through their
practice
routines. A large number of trainers have
gathered to watch.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ohohoho! I'm sure you were all dying to see me! Ohoho... Cough.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, if it isn't King. Did you sprint
all the way here just to make
it in time?
Take a little break and catch your breath,
okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As if I need a break! There are more
important things right now. Look
around
you—all these trainers have gathered here
to observe my
prowess!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Rest is for the weak! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well... You do you, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, King! I'm glad you came too. I was
about to start training. Do
you want to
join?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Sky, come with us too. I'll give
you the honor of eating my
dust!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay! Last one there bites the dust!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey! No cheating!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What, are we starting already?! Wait for
me!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well if it isn't the trickster Seiun Sky,
the hard-working Special
Week, and the
well-to-do King Halo.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
They certainly have their own quirks! I'm
excited to see how those
three will
perform in the tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the sidelines, I watch as King Halo
and the others race excitedly
against each
other.
